name: Fake motorcycle officer (generic, anonymous, helmeted silhouette)
depiction: The unidentified robber. Drawn ONLY as a rim-lit silhouette (silhouette: 'cool'/'warm') with a white helmet and a dark visor drawn over the head by the scene file, so no face is ever shown. Plain dark uniform-style jacket with no badge, patch, number, crest or lettering; no weapon. Never identified, never a likeness of anyone; no suspect is suggested.
